Are you talking about pressing the letter "J" on a touchscreen or physically keyboard? Is the question in relation to Thunderbird for Android (this forum) or the desktop version?

Emails marked as spam in the mobile app are simply moved to the spam/junk folder. The app does offer any spam filtering. Email providers normally filter spam and allow users to create server side filtering rules.
